relationships.subject: lamina I spinoparabrachial projection neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Mouse SPBNs from both regions (laminae I and III-V) were often seen to give off local axon collaterals, and we provide neuroanatomical evidence they contribute to excitatory input to dorsal horn circuits.

key_findings: Unbiased hierarchical clustering of 79 mouse lamina I spinoparabrachial projection neurons resolved two major groups and four distinct electrophysiological subpopulations, showing these projection neurons are heterogeneous rather than a uniform class.

Deep (laminae III-V) spinoparabrachial neurons fired at higher frequencies and received weaker excitatory synaptic input than lamina I neurons, and SPBN axon collaterals were VGLUT2-positive and apposed to Homer1 puncta, indicating they provide excitatory input back into dorsal horn circuits.
